reason: Critical functionality is missing: main() is empty, so the simulation produces no output and fails verification. There is also a substantive compliance metric bias and a parameter-model mismatch for fatigue. With one iteration remaining before the max, a focused pass can implement a functional main(), fix compliance averaging, align fatigue dynamics with configured parameters, and address minor performance/style issues. These changes will likely flip verification to pass and materially improve correctness.

specific_areas: Implement main() to parse CLI/JSON params, run the simulation, and print JSON results; ensure __main__ invokes main()
Fix compliance averaging by appending None on days with no mandated visits and averaging only over non-None days (or track cumulative mandated masked/total counts)
Align fatigue dynamics with fatigue_rate by passing a rate parameter to update_fatigue and scaling deltas accordingly
Optimize small-world rewiring by replacing O(n) candidate list-building with bounded random attempts
Remove redundant pass statements and unused imports/constants; actually use argparse/json in main()
Ensure results schema is stable and includes compliance as None when inapplicable; adoption metrics populated
Add deterministic seeding via params and guarantee default parameters produce quick, non-empty outputs

task_understanding.adjustments: Prioritize making the program executable and verifiable by the harness; ensure main() runs the simulation and emits JSON to stdout.

data_analysis.adjustments: Redefine compliance aggregation to exclude non-applicable days; consider cumulative counts for robustness and clarity.

model_planning.adjustments: Tie behavioral fatigue dynamics to the configured fatigue_rate parameter; document or encode intended up/down scaling.

code_generation.adjustments: Implement CLI parsing (argparse) for params, integrate json loading, print results via json.dumps; remove redundant pass and unused imports; optimize small-world rewiring loop.

code_verification.adjustments: Add a smoke test that executes the script and validates that stdout is valid JSON with expected keys; unit-check compliance averaging skips None days; verify fatigue_rate influences fatigue trajectory.

simulation_execution.adjustments: Ensure Simulation.run() is invoked with default params, returns results, and uses update_fatigue(wore_mask, rate=fatigue_rate); preserve reproducibility with a seed parameter.

result_evaluation.adjustments: Compute compliance averages only over valid days and return None when inapplicable; confirm adoption and inventory metrics are populated and consistent.

feedback_generation.adjustments: Keep feedback concise and action-oriented; include minimal code snippets for main(), compliance fix, fatigue scaling, and rewiring optimization.
